verdict.rationale: Trivy is a security scanner, not an AI agent or host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in other MCP servers and calls their tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite direction: trivy-mcp runs Trivy as an MCP server for other MCP-enabled tools, which is server-side and does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
